facts.fact: Loi n°2021-014 of 5 July 2021 on electronic payment services and means (113 articles, published in Journal Officiel n°1490) regulates payment service providers and e-money issuers in Mauritania and repeals Ordonnance n°2006-031 (art. 1, 112).
facts.system: Loi n°2021-014 relative aux services et moyens de paiement électronique

facts.fact: Loi n°2021-014 (2021) bars anyone except banks from habitual payment-institution activity or e-money issuance and distribution without prior licensing by the Banque Centrale de Mauritanie, so non-bank payment institutions and e-money institutions can be licensed (art. 65, 80; defined art. 64, 75).
facts.system: Loi n°2021-014 relative aux services et moyens de paiement électronique

note: Art. 55 and 86 require institutions to meet central-bank technical rules enabling interoperability, but the law states no obligation to connect to each other or to a switch, so no connect fact.
